name: Memo
source:
Memo is a slice of life story set in an unnamed Japanese city that is neither large nor small.  Over the course of a few days, one will experience the life of a transfer student named Seji who has moved several times a year for most of his life.  Compelling experiences spur the youth forward as he reconnects with a childhood town.

[From [url=https://renai.us/game/memo]Ren'ai archive[/url]]
